name: draft_outreach
description: Deterministic outreach drafter. Replaces the LLM `outreach_drafter` agent. Reads the candidate row, their dossier (already authored by parse_intake), and the role pitch from /knowledge/roles/<slug>/pitch.md; composes a real first-touch message in the founder's voice (per /knowledge/founder-voice.md). Output shape matches the agent — subject + body + voice_check — so downstream record_draft is unchanged.
